extracted.name: Chef Bill's Green Bean Almondine with Cranberries
extracted.description: Green beans tossed with cranberries, brown butter, and almonds are finished with a splash of orange juice in this flavorful side dish.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 teaspoon garlic powder, or to taste
2 tablespoons sweetened dried cranberries (such as Craisins®)
instruction_lines: Heat butter in a small skillet over medium heat until it starts to brown and smell nutty, 3 to 5 minutes. Add green beans, garlic powder, and salt; cook and stir until beans are tender, about 2 minutes.
Add almonds and cranberries; toss lightly to combine. Add orange juice and season with white pepper.
